title: Office Space - If I had a million dollars
summary: A 54-second clip from the film Office Space in which two coworkers talk about what they would do with a million dollars. The answers contrast blue-collar and white-collar attitudes toward work.
why: Mostly a joke reference in threads about layoffs, idleness and wealth, with one commenter sincerely recommending the clip for its contrast of work attitudes.

quote.text: Highly recommend to watch the clip from the movie Office Space (only 54 sec long)
